headline: World Bank Identifies Off-Grid Solar as Cheapest Power for 398 Million
summary: A joint study by the World Bank's ESMAP and GOGLA established off-grid solar as the lowest-cost technology to provide electricity to 398 million unserved people, treating the systems as permanent energy infrastructure.
why: Decentralized renewable energy offers scalable electrification for rural regions across developing nations, opening substantial project finance opportunities for international development banks and clean-tech providers.

impacts.name: Off-Grid Solar
impacts.why: World Bank recognition as permanent infrastructure supports institutional funding allocations.
